title: A stranger who types a member's mobile number when joining the app gets the gym's messages meant for that member
what: When someone joins a gym in the member app, the server keeps whatever mobile number the join sends, with no check. The admin app then treats that number as proof of who the person is: the App members list opens the real member's page for them, a message sent to a member or a group (from Messages or the AI Assistant) is delivered in the app to anyone whose join number matches, and the real member is marked as already on the app, so the WhatsApp list leaves them out. The server itself no longer trusts a typed number for check-ins (the desk must confirm it), but the admin app still does for messages. Today's app sends no number at join, so this needs someone calling the server directly with the gym code and a member's number.
expected: The admin app should match app members to its member list only by a number the desk confirmed (the check-in number), never by the number typed at join.
how_often: only when someone does it on purpose
fix_line: Send the panel the desk-confirmed check-in number instead of the typed join number, and stop the server keeping a number at join

title: Anyone with the gym's code can fill its shop and its member messages with fake app members, and the gym cannot remove them
what: The gym's code is on the invite link, the check-in poster and the 'Become a member' link the gym shares publicly. With it, a script can join the gym up to 500 times an hour under made-up names. Each fake member can place 15 shop orders an hour, and every order takes the stock at once, so real members see products as sold out until the desk cancels each order by hand. Each fake member can also open 5 message threads a day (feedback can be anonymous). The limits are per app member, not per gym, and the admin app has no way to remove or block an app member.
expected: A per-gym cap on new open orders and new message threads from app members who are not on the gym's list, and a way for the owner to remove an app member.
who: owners, desk staff and real members
how_often: only when someone does it on purpose
fix_line: Cap open orders and new threads per gym from unlinked app members, and add a remove button on App members
